    The ring of centre words and its twisted traces #

    Proof of Lemmas A.3–A.4 in algebraic form. The centre corner of Π(Δ) for a star with arms of L i + 1 vertices is a quotient of ℤ⟨x_1, …, x_t⟩ / (∑ x_i, x_i^{L i + 2}) (eq:star-corner-presentation; the coefficients of all relations are integers). A twisted trace on words is an additive function tr on words, compatible with these relations, with tr (u v) = tr (v θ(u)) and tr (x_i^q) = 0 for arms fixed by θ. It descends to an additive map on the quotient ring R, in which the calculations of Appendix A are ring identities.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

                  structure LargeIndecomposable.TraceAlg.TraceData {t : ℕ} (L : Fin t → ℕ) (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] :
                  Type u_1

                  A twisted trace on words for the star with arms of L i + 1 vertices.

                  • tr : List (Fin t) → M
                  • θ : Equiv.Perm (Fin t)
                  • hL (i : Fin t) : L (self.θ i) = L i
                  • rotate (u v : List (Fin t)) : self.tr (u ++ v) = self.tr (v ++ List.map (⇑self.θ) u)
                  • centre (u v : List (Fin t)) : ∑ i : Fin t, self.tr (u ++ i :: v) = 0
                  • arm (u v : List (Fin t)) (i : Fin t) : self.tr (u ++ List.replicate (L i + 2) i ++ v) = 0
                  • fixed (i : Fin t) : self.θ i = i → ∀ (q : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → self.tr (List.replicate q i) = 0
